text:
ayan: Quick dry-run thread for the Marketplace GA tomorrow. Main asks: confirm HW partner image version, marketplace listing metadata (pricing/SKUs), SI test-mode toggle, and embargo window for press. Link to checklist: https://notion.redwood/marketplace/ga-checklist

rebekah: I pulled the catalog metadata from staging: price tiers set, SKU mappings done, but we need final partner logos (svg) and the 1-line tagline. assets bucket: s3://marketplace-assets/ga/ 

diego: SI test harness ran against partner staging last night. Two flaky tests left for auth handshake. Logged at https://ci.redwood/si/9876. If we can't resolve, we flip FEATURE_SI_FASTPATH=false for canary.

nina: visual assets ready except APAC banners (JP, KR). Chris-hw can you confirm partner logos are cleared for use? Need licensing note in listing copy.

chris-hw: Confirmed with HW legal; logos approved for marketplace listing v1. Partner image version to ship: 2.4.1-b. Note: firmware 5.2.0 required for Dedicated edge.

pm-beth: For rollout, proposal: Canary A (NA) 09:00 PST, Canary B (EMEA) 13:00 UTC, Full GA 16:00 UTC. Press embargo at GA+10m. Thoughts?

sara-legal: Embargo ok with those windows. Two legal edits: (1) add the partner attribution line, (2) include privacy link to the private deployment docs. I'll drop a PR to the copydoc.

ayan: Good. Rebekah, please attach final svg files here when uploaded. Diego, what's ETA on auth flaky tests?

rebekah: Uploaded logos to s3://marketplace-assets/ga/logos with filename convention partnername-v2.svg. I added a small 1-line tagline candidate in Notion.

diego: Debugging auth - root cause looks like token expiry simulation in harness. Patch in review, ETA 3 hours. If delayed, we'll set FEATURE_SI_FASTPATH=false for canary to skip handshake path.

nina: Banners for JP/KR in progress. Will upload by 05:30 UTC. Will also add a screenshot of the listing mobile/desktop.

chris-hw: FYI partners requested marketplace listing to show cert badge. I have the image and copy in the assets path. Also confirming firmware rollout schedule with ops.

pm-beth: Ops please ensure firmware 5.2.0 is in the dedicated pool prior to GA. Otherwise we need to hide the Dedicated SKU until later. @ops-team

launchbot: Reminder: preflight runs at T-30m and T-10m. Publish hooks will block until preflight passes.

ayan: Quick checklist (react when done):
- rebekah: logos & tagline uploaded
- nina: JP/KR banners + screenshots
- chris-hw: cert badge + firmware confirm
- diego: SI auth flaky tests fixed or fallback flag set
- sara-legal: final copy PR merged
- pm-beth: schedule confirmed and ops notified

rebekah: Logos + tagline done :white_check_mark:. Took care to include alt text for accessibility.

nina: JP/KR banners uploaded, screenshots attached to Notion. Mobile looks tight on long taglines, trimmed copy slightly. :white_check_mark:

chris-hw: Firmware confirmed for GA pool. Cert badge asset present. :white_check_mark:

diego: Patch merged. Auth tests now pass locally. CI rerun queued. If CI fails, fallback flag ready.

sara-legal: PR merged and small privacy link added. Also added embargo reminder to press template.

pm-beth: Schedule locked. Ops acknowledged firmware window. Canary slots reserved. :white_check_mark:

ayan: Great. Two operational notes: (1) Marketplace listing analytics hook must be wired before GA (event: marketplace.install), (2) promo code allocation for partners needs to be seeded: CODE_PARTNER50 -> 500 redemptions. Ops to confirm quota.

rebekah: Analytics event wired to segment staging. QA event shows up in the stream.

chris-hw: Promo code quota discussed with finance; 500 redemptions approved. I'll confirm implementation.

launchbot: Preflight (T-30m) result: assets=true, legal=true, si_tests=running, analytics_hook=true. Next preflight at T-10m.

diego: CI auth tests passed. SI harness green. No fallback needed.

ayan: Preflight T-10m now. Everyone report status here.

rebekah: assets ok. logos validated across breakpoints.

nina: screenshots OK. mobile/desktop verified.

chris-hw: firmware in GA pool, cert badge visible on staging listing.

sara-legal: legal OK on final page copy and press template.

pm-beth: ops confirmed promo code seeded and quota set. Schedule go for canaries.

launchbot: Preflight (T-10m) result: PASS. Proceeding to Canary A (NA) at scheduled time. Logs: https://ci.redwood/marketplace/ga/4567

ayan: Canary A started. Monitoring dashboard: https://dash.redwood/marketplace/ga. Watch for install rate and error spikes.

rebekah: Canary A installs look healthy. No major regressions.

diego: SI interactions are clean. Auth handshake stable.

pm-beth: Canary B (EMEA) starting now.

nina: Visual QA on Canary B spot-checked - minor alignment issue on IE fallback, not blocking.

chris-hw: Partner telemetry shows expected heartbeats from firmware v5.2.0.

ayan: All canaries stable. Moving to full GA now. Press embargo reminder: do not distribute until GA+10m.

launchbot: GA deploy initiated. Post-deploy hooks: blog_publish blocked until web CDN invalidation completes. CDN run: https://ci.redwood/cdn/9988

rebekah: CDN invalidation done. Site serving new assets.

ayan: GO for blog publish at GA+10m. Social queued. Press outreach template sent to comms.

pm-beth: Announcements scheduled. Thanks team 389

sara-legal: Closing on legal side. Will archive copy in the legal docs.

chris-hw: Closing loop with partner. They requested a post-GA telemetry report; I'll coordinate with infra.

diego: SI lead confirms full onboarding completed. No followups required.

ayan: Excellent. Thread closed after postmortem notes in Notion.
